S0582.reason: Bladder outflow obstruction, such as from benign prostatic hyperplasia, is the most common cause of acute urinary retention.

S0587.reason: Universal jurisdiction allows any state to claim jurisdiction over certain serious crimes regardless of where they were committed or the nationality of the perpetrator.
